# Monochrome

Monochrome is ESP-IDF firmware for an ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8). It drives a TTL monochrome monitor of the [MDA](reference/glossary.md#term-mda) or Hercules type through a DE-9 connector. The firmware joins Wi-Fi and shows frames that a program on your network sends over TCP or UDP, with optional compression. It also includes a shaded 3D torus knot that runs at 49 frames per second, a wireframe screensaver and a calibration pattern, all drawn with three brightness levels.

Start with [Build and flash](start/build-and-flash.md), then [Send frames over Wi-Fi](guides/send-frames-over-wifi.md).
